name: Gakuen Inkitan ~Kaori Tsuki no Shoujo~
original_name: 学園淫奇譚～かおり憑きの少女～
source: In Misono private school, there's a strange rumor about a female student becoming sexually free-spirited and causing trouble both inside and outside the school. The rumor got a name Kaori Tsuki after a person who caused a previous incident that led to the school becoming co-educational. It's believed to be a mere creation of some students until the protagonist, Mitsui Toshiki, becomes the target of an evil spirit named Kaori, who wants to break up him and his girlfriend, Tokimori Shiina. The story revolves around the struggle of Toshiki to overcome his dark desires and save his girlfriend while unraveling the mystery of an evil spirit.
translation: 私立Misono学园里流传着一个奇怪的传闻，某位女学生突然变得性观念奔放，在校内外惹出种种麻烦。人们根据过去一起促成学校改为男女同校的事件中的当事人，将这个传闻称为“香织附身”。大家原以为这只是学生编造的故事，直到主人公光井俊希被名叫香织的恶灵盯上。她企图拆散俊希与女友土岐森椎奈。故事围绕俊希的挣扎展开，他必须克服内心的阴暗欲望，拯救女友，同时解开恶灵的谜团。
